_comment: AC-11 audit baseline for CAS_C8A9A3EC0935498880A468625FE3F490 (lean cleanup). Captured 2026-06-13 on branch `lean` BEFORE any deletion work. The contract is 'no NEW findings vs this baseline': the deletions must not INTRODUCE net-new dangling/unused/missing_doc/wrong_breadcrumb/stale_doc. Deleting dead routes is EXPECTED to REDUCE crossing-audit.unused (fewer served-but-uncalled routes) and js-audit.unreachable is unchanged by this pass (the 6 orphan framework JS twins are flag-not-cut per R-2). Re-run the three audits after the work; compare against these numbers. A reviewer/ops gate, not a unit test.

crossing_audit._note: dangling must not GROW. unused is EXPECTED to DROP as DEAD routes are removed (demo/docs/companies/teams/users + cases CRUD + cases/:rid/members). A drop in `unused` is the success signal, not a regression.

js_audit._note: Unchanged by this pass. The 6 orphan framework JS twins (comments/profile-record/settings-config/avatar-upload/filter-panel/tools-panel.js) are part of this 21 and are flag-not-cut (R-2, out of scope) — only their CSS sheets are cut (AC-4). So unreachable count holds; it must not GROW.

css_audit._note: AC-1 oracle. orphans=[] and dangling_imports=[] today. After AC-3/AC-4 (admin.css + 6 framework sheets deleted WITH their @import lines), orphans must stay [] and dangling_imports must stay [] — a half-delete (@import to a missing file) would surface here as a dangling_import. This is the structural guard that the sheet+@import are disposed together.

doc_coverage_audit._note: AC-10/AC-11 oracle. After deleting route modules + their atomic docs in the SAME commit, these must show NO NEW missing_doc / wrong_breadcrumb / stale_doc. orphan_doc could legitimately DROP (a doc whose source we deleted should be deleted too); it must not GROW. Deleting a .rs without its .md would show as orphan_doc++ or a dangling Doc breadcrumb.
